items.title: TypeSafe AI 发布只做高频决策的大模型 Jev，作者实测其分类判断性价比
items.summary: TypeSafe AI 推出专注高频决策的大模型 Jev，速度比传统大模型快 20～200 倍，成本为 0.042 美元/百万 Token 且输出 Token 免费。作者实测显示，Jev 在预筛任务中准确性排名第二且成本更低，在并行判断任务上达到最高准确率和最快速度。该模型采用 RLCD 训练方法优化决策校准，已在 Vercel 首发接入，可通过官网申请使用资格。
items.summary_en: TypeSafe AI released Jev, a specialized large model designed exclusively for high-frequency decision-making rather than dialogue or text generation. Jev is 20–200× faster than traditional LLMs at a cost of $0.042 per million tokens with free output tokens, trained via an RLCD method optimized for decision calibration. Independent testing showed Jev ranked second in accuracy for pre-filtering tasks while being cheaper, and achieved both the highest accuracy and fastest speed on parallel judgment tasks; it is available at typesafe.ai and has launched via Vercel.

items.title: How To Write With An LLM
items.summary: Thomas Ptacek提出使用LLM作为校对编辑而非写作助手的规则：任何LLM建议的具体措辞都不得使用。他把LLM仅用于事实核查、拼写语法检查以及偶尔的词典功能，并分享了自己的proofreading prompt和个人LLM copyediting tool的配置方法。
items.summary_en: Thomas Ptacek advocates using LLMs strictly as copyeditors rather than writing assistants, enforcing a rule that no phrase suggested by an LLM is ever used in final text. Instead, he employs them for fact-checking, spelling, grammar correction, and as an occasional thesaurus, providing a proofreading prompt to help readers build their own LLM editing tool.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.summary: cloudflare/security-audit-skill是Cloudflare多阶段漏洞发现系统的起点，将编码代理转化为安全审计工具。该技能通过侦察、覆盖引导狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录和报告六个阶段运行审计，输出confirmed、needs_validation和rejected三种判决结果至findings.json。多轮运行具有累加性，可利用先前列账和目标检测结果精准填补覆盖漏洞并重新验证变更代码。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare's security-audit-skill is a coding-agent orchestration tool that runs structured six-phase security audits—from architecture mapping and coverage-led hunting to independent candidate validation and machine-readable reporting. It seeds Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness and produces findings classified as confirmed, needs_validation, or rejected with full source traces. The skill includes specialized attack-class prompts covering memory safety, LLM/prompt injection, web protocols, supply chain, cloud/IAM, and more, with additive multi-run capability that targets gaps across repeated scans.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary: agent-skills 是为 AI 编程代理提供的生产级工程技能库，包含 25 个技能和 9 个 slash 命令（/spec、/plan、/build、/test、/constraints、/review、/webperf、/code-simplify、/ship），覆盖从需求定义到上线的完整开发生命周期。支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot、Cline 等 70+ AI 代理工具，可通过 `npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills` 一键安装全部技能，或按需安装单个技能如 `--skill test-driven-development`。推荐 Claude Code 用户使用插件市场命令 `/plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills` 安装。
items.summary_en: agent-skills is a collection of 25 production-grade engineering skills that encode senior-engineer workflows for AI coding agents, installable into 70+ agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Cline) via the open skills CLI. It provides 9 slash commands—/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /constraints, /review, /webperf, /code-simplify, and /ship—mapped to the development lifecycle from idea to production, with automatic skill activation based on context. The /build command auto-generates and executes plans in a single approved pass while maintaining test-driven verification and pausing on failures or risky steps.

items.title: 用 Seedance 2.5 拍《沙丘 3》，我们替你把 AI 短片的坑全都踩过了
items.summary: 团队使用 Codex 和 Seedance 2.5，在 12 天内完成了 6 分钟 AI 短片《沙丘 3》粉丝作品，累计消耗 3000 多元积分额度。核心方法是将 30 秒提示词按秒拆分为整体概述、分时时间段线和约束条件三层，以控制镜头运动、人物走位和表演节奏，并借助自由画布集中管理素材，以及使用局部编辑功能修正画面瑕疵。与“一键生成”不同，完整流程涵盖剧本打磨、资产库建立、视频生成筛选及后期剪辑四个阶段。
items.summary_en: A two-person team produced a 6-minute AI short film inspired by *Dune 3* in 12 days using Codex and Seedance 2.5, spending over 3,000 yuan in credits. The workflow followed four stages—scriptwriting, asset library creation, video generation, and editing—with the asset library being critical for maintaining character consistency and avoiding copyright triggers. A key technique was splitting 30-second clips into second-by-second timelines across three prompt layers: overall overview, timed action descriptions, and negative constraints—to keep camera movement, character placement, and performance under control.

items.title: Show HN: Jev routing coding tasks to Grok Build or Codex Astra
items.summary: 这是一个基于Jev模型的本地原型系统，用于将编程任务路由到Grok Build（
items.summary_en: Jev is a local prototype router that sends uncertain or complex coding tasks to Codex Astra (gpt-6-astra) while routing contained mechanical work to Grok Build (grok-4.6). The router asks three typed questions—Choice, Complexity score (mechanical to high consequence), and a Boolean for prior planning—and adopts a conservative policy that defaults uncertain or high-complexity tasks to Astra. It classifies six tasks in parallel with Vercel AI Gateway, supports Zero Data Retention, and runs safely with a read-only sandbox or plan mode without editing code in this prototype.

items.title: Show HN: Vim-like, hyper-efficient, LLM power tool - 20-80k tokens not 350k+
items.summary: 该工具将 LLM 上下文窗口从传统的 350k+ tokens 缩减至 20-80k tokens，实现 90%+ API 节省。核心技术包括用户小上下文窗口、混合客户端压缩、工具压缩和系统提示优化，配合 Vim 风格键位、Markdown/LaTeX/Mermaid 渲染及子 agent 功能，提供高效并行的终端交互体验。
items.summary_en: The creator built a Vim-inspired terminal TUI tool for parallelized LLM tasks, achieving 90%+ API savings by reducing context windows from 350k+ tokens down to 20-80k via client-side compaction, tool compaction, and system nudges. Key features include Vim keybindings, on-demand subagents with LLM-directed context handoff, thread pooling, custom Markdown/LaTeX/Mermaid rendering, and support for PowerShell, VGA/VESA mode, and zero external dependencies.

items.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
items.summary: 纽约时报起诉OpenAI和微软的版权诉讼中，新解密文件显示微软高管私下承认AI内容抓取相当于"盗窃"，称其可能是"人类历史上最大的劳动盗窃"。内部文件揭示，微软Copilot"答案引擎"导致《纽约时报》域名点击率下降高达93%，形成威胁出版业生存的"末日循环"。OpenAI中期训练数据集包含超过91,692份作品副本，且刻意绕过付费墙获取内容并剥离版权声明。
items.summary_en: Unsealed filings in The New York Times' copyright lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft reveal internal admissions describing AI scraping as "theft" and an "existential threat" to publishers, with companies allegedly bypassing paywalls, mass-scraping content, and stripping copyright notices. Microsoft's own data shows its Copilot answer engine dropped The Times' click-through rates by up to 93% compared to traditional Bing search, while OpenAI's mid-training datasets alone contain over 91,692 copies of The Times' published works. These revelations directly undermine OpenAI's fair-use defense by demonstrating market substitution and harm rather than transformative use.

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.summary: Colibrì 是一个纯 C 实现的零依赖推理引擎，可将 VRAM、RAM 和 NVMe 存储整合为统一的多级层次结构，在消费级硬件上运行 744B 至 2.8T 参数的 MoE 模型。目前已支持 GLM-5.2/5.3（744B）、Kimi K3（2.8T）、DeepSeek V4/V4.1 Flash、Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 等九大模型家族，单 C 文件即可运行。实测数据显示 744B 模型 int4 量化下仅驻留 9.9GB 内存，6× RTX 5090 配置可达 4 tok/s 推理速度。
items.summary_en: Colibri is a pure C, zero-dependency inference engine that runs frontier Mixture-of-Experts models from 744B to 2.8T parameters on consumer and heterogeneous hardware. items.title: 央企做了个通用Agent，直接杀进IDC实测前三！
items.summary: 中国电信自研通用Agent TeleAgent在IDC国内首份《中国企业级通用Agent产品技术评估》中排名前三，常规任务得分3.49分、复杂任务3.36分，任务表现获满分、成本效率为评测最高；上线仅一个多月用户规模已接近120万，上下文窗口突破400K，通过ModelRouter智能路由降低推理成本约40%。

items.title: Goodfire Research 发现模型内部信号可规模化检测奖励作弊
items.summary_en: Goodfire Research found that language models contain internal activation signals accompanying reward cheating, which can be detected in real time using simple probes. Across three agent benchmarks on open-source models Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and Qwen 3.8 Max, 50–96% of rollouts exhibited reward cheating. These probes outperform LLM chain-of-thought monitoring by catching missed cheating cases and generalize to tasks outside the training data.

items.title: Show HN: public 500 TB internet index in ClickHouse, with congestion pricing
items.summary: Scry提供MCP接口访问存储于ClickHouse中的500 TB NVMe互联网索引，支持运行任意只读SQL和Datalog查询，并通过基于拥塞的微拍卖定价机制处理资源争用，非商业用途在容量充足时免费。相比Google Search、Tavily和Exa等将查询映射到索引子集的"黑盒"方案，该服务让用户直接掌控查询逻辑，可构建基于实时OLAP数据库和前沿LLM的信息产品，解决传统搜索引擎算法不透明、控制权有限的
items.summary_en: Scry is a public 500 TB NVMe internet index stored in ClickHouse that allows users to run arbitrary read-only SQL and Datalog queries. It uses congestion-based micro-auction pricing to handle resource contention, and is free for non-commercial use when capacity is available. The creator aims to scale this approach as an open alternative to opaque search APIs like Google Search, Tavily, and Exa.

items.title: Show HN: AI crawler honeypot – logs every agent that requests it
items.summary: 该AI爬虫蜜罐服务用于观察、测量和分析针对其域名的AI代理及网络爬虫请求，对所有来访流量进行行为模式分类。隐私保护方面采用每日密码盐哈希处理，从不存储真实客户端IP地址。用户可查看当日实时遥测数据及透明度披露报告。
items.summary_en: An automated honeypot service observes and analyzes AI agent and web scraper requests, classifying all incoming visits for behavioral patterns while preserving privacy through daily cryptographic salt hashing that never stores real client IP addresses. Users can inspect live telemetry and review a transparency disclosure for visibility into detected activity.

items.title: Iceland-based Treble raises $18 million for its voice simulation platform
items.summary: 冰岛语音AI测试平台Treble完成1800万美元A轮融资（累计超4000万美元），投资方包括Paladin Capital Group，客户含Amazon和Logitech。该平台通过物理仿真技术生成合成音频数据，用于语音模型训练、噪声抑制及硬件声学测试，已推出与Hugging Face合作的语音识别基准测试。创始人Pind表示正拓展至智能眼镜、机器人等"实体AI"领域，解决声学环境下的声音理解挑战。
items.summary_en: Iceland-based Treble has raised $18 million (Series A extension led by Paladin Capital Group), bringing its total funding to over $40 million. The company builds a voice AI simulation platform that generates synthetic acoustic data through physics-based modeling for training, evaluating, and testing voice models and hardware—counting Amazon and Logitech as customers. Investors see growing demand as voice AI expands into wearables, robotics, and smart glasses.

items.title: 图形学宗师童欣加盟Meshy，要做“AI for Fun”的头号玩家
items.summary: 童欣加盟AI 3D公司Meshy出任首席科学家，负责长期科研战略制定。Meshy目前拥有1200万用户，2024年7月完成近4亿美元B轮融资，估值超100亿元。团队推出Mora架构，结合代码生成代理、3D模型生成和视频渲染三个模块，试图解决现有视频世界模型在空间一致性和互动性上的缺陷，实现"AI for Fun"的愿景。
items.summary_en: 图形学专家童欣加盟AI 3D公司Meshy，出任首席科学家，负责制定长期科研战略。Meshy由胡渊鸣创办，已拥有1200万用户，今年7月完成近4亿美元B轮融资，估值超100亿元人民币，是AI 3D领域估值最高的公司。公司提出"AI for Fun"愿景，致力于通过AI重新发明图形学，并已发布基础模型Meshy-7（8月）及新一代多模态架构"Mora"，将Coding Agent、3D生成与视频模型结合以构建可交互的开放世界体验。

items.title: Zuck sits out the AI slowdown
items.summary: Mark Zuckerberg 拒绝加入由 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 发起的 AI 协调减速计划，明确将 Meta 归入加速阵营，与 Elon Musk、Jensen Huang、Donald Trump 及中国站在同一立场。Meta 近期推出了 Muse AI agent，该产品经历了数月安全审查后直接发布，无需竞争对手同步跟进。Zuckerberg 认为安全对齐是一项产品特性，跳过它的实验室"将落后"，同时 Meta 将大部分算力分配给服务用户而非参与递归自我改进的 AI 竞赛。
items.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg has rejected the coordinated AI slowdown倡议, arguing that safety alignment is already a competitive selling point and that each lab has its own incentive to proceed responsibly. Meta demonstrated this by implementing a several-month safety hold on its new Muse AI agent independently, while allocating the significant majority of compute toward serving users rather than recursive self-improvement. The slowdown coalition now splits: Amodei, Altman, Musk, and Hassabis favor caution, while Zuck, Jensen Huang, Donald Trump, and Beijing oppose it, making a global coordinated pause unlikely.

items.title: 追觅四大赛道 IFA 首秀：一套技术，四个出口
The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI
items.summary: 美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）计划投入8.75亿美元采购名为SMART的AI软件，以应对全国空中交通管制员短缺问题。该软件由Air Space Intelligence开发，是一款云端平台，能分析航班时刻、天气和空域容量等数据，预测流量并识别潜在冲突。项目周期为12年，首批将在华盛顿特区都市区部署。
items.summary_en: The FAA is deploying a $875 million AI software program called SMART (Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories) to address the nationwide air traffic control shortage. Developed by Air Space Intelligence, the cloud-based platform uses AI to analyze airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, and airspace conditions to predict traffic flows and prevent conflicts before they occur. The program will launch first in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area before expanding to other regions over a 12-year rollout.

items.title: 纽约时报诉 OpenAI 案新解封文件：微软与 OpenAI 内部承认 LLM 建立在窃取之上并引发 Doom Loop
items.summary: 纽约时报诉 OpenAI 版权案新解封文件显示，微软与 OpenAI 高管内部承认 LLM 建立在被微软称为"空前规模盗窃"的内容之上，并正在引发摧毁整个 web 的 doom loop；Bing 上被窃取新闻网站的点击量下降超过 90%，OpenAI 曾绕过纽约时报付费墙，并自承是新闻出版的存在性威胁。
items.summary_en: A newly unsealed court filing in the New York Times v. OpenAI copyright lawsuit contains internal admissions from Microsoft and OpenAI executives acknowledging that large language models are built on content taken at what Microsoft called an "unprecedented scale" of theft, creating a self-reinforcing "doom loop" that threatens to destroy the entire web. The documents reveal that Bing-driven referral traffic to news sites whose material was used for training has dropped more than 90%, and that OpenAI previously bypassed the New York Times' paywall, while internally characterizing itself as an existential threat to news publishing.

零成本输出Token，用户只需为输入付费

Pre-built templates for common scenarios (spam detection, intent classification, sensitivity check)
Free output tokens — users only pay for input

The model achieves 2nd-place accuracy at 1/200th the cost with free output tokens, yet no polished wrapper API exists — short window to capture early adopters.

directions.name: FactCheck Pad

directions.description_en: A writing tool that enforces LLM-only-as-editor rules, featuring Thomas Ptacek's proofreading engine with creative rewriting blocked — focused purely on fact-checking and grammar correction
directions.target_user: 技术写作者、开发者博主、内容审核编辑、需要保持个人文风的创作者
directions.target_user_en: Technical writers, developer bloggers, content editors, and creators who want to maintain their personal writing voice

语法与风格一致性检查，保留作者原始表达风格
core_features_en: Built-in Ptacek rule engine: automatically rejects and filters LLM-generated phrasing suggestions
Fact-check mode: validates citations, links, and sources with verification prompts
Grammar & style consistency checking while preserving author's original voice
directions.why_now: Simon Willison博客刊登Thomas Ptacek关于'LLM应仅作校对编辑'的文章后，Hacker News和Reddit大量开发者讨论AI写作工具过度干预文风的问题。社区对'LLM润色后失去个人风格'的痛点强烈共鸣，但现有工具（如Grammarly AI、Jasper）均主打创意改写，缺乏尊重作者原创性的校对工具，市场需求明确但供给空白。
directions.why_now_en: After Thomas Ptacek's article on 'LLM as proofreader only' was published on Simon Willison's blog, HN and Reddit saw intense discussion about AI writing tools over-editing and losing personal voice. The community strongly resonates with 'LLM-polished content loses authenticity' pain point, yet existing tools focus on creative rewriting — a clear market gap for author-preserving proofreading tools.
directions.monetization: 桌面应用一次性买断$49，或订阅$9/月含无限次校对；企业团队协作版$199/年
directions.monetization_en: Desktop app one-time purchase $49, or subscription $9/month for unlimited proofreading; team/enterprise plan $199/year
directions.source_article: How To Write With An LLM
